title: AWAKENING IN HIS
LIKENESS
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: golden sunrise over misty pine forest
close up morning dew on wild grass
soft sunlight entering an empty room
mountain peak glowing at first light
sunlight rays through morning forest leaves

scenes.a: That recurring doubt about your worth is ready to be laid down at His feet.
As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
Lord, help me to look past the fleeting shadows of this world and fix my gaze on You.
May the peace of Your presence sustain me throughout the demands of the day ahead now.
Grant me the grace to walk in the light of Your character, reflecting Your love clearly.
In the name of Jesus, I rest in the truth that You are my only satisfaction.
